entries.title: Psalms 119:1
segments: <<aALEPH.>> Blessed are they that are  perfect in the way, Who walk in the law of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 119:2
segments: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, That seek him with the whole heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:3
segments: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; They walk in his ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:4
segments: Thou hast commanded [us] thy precepts, That we should observe them diligently.

entries.title: Psalms 119:5
segments: Oh that my ways were established To observe thy statutes!

entries.title: Psalms 119:6
segments: Then shall I not be put to shame, When I have respect unto all thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:7
segments: I will give thanks unto thee with uprightness of heart, When I learn thy righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:8
segments: I will observe thy statutes: Oh forsake me not utterly.

entries.title: Psalms 119:9
segments: Wherewith shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed [thereto] according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:10
segments: With my whole heart have I sought thee: Oh let me not wander from thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:11
segments: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, That I might not sin against thee.

entries.title: Psalms 119:12
segments: Blessed art thou, O Jehovah: Teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:13
segments: With my lips have I declared All the ordinances of thy mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:14
segments: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.

entries.title: Psalms 119:15
segments: I will meditate on thy precepts, And have respect unto thy ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:16
segments: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:17
segments: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live; So will I observe thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:18
segments: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold Wondrous things out of thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:19
segments: I am a sojourner in the earth: Hide not thy commandments from me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:20
segments: My soul breaketh for the longing That it hath unto thine ordinances at all times.

entries.title: Psalms 119:21
segments: Thou hast rebuked the proud  that are cursed, That do wander from thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:22
segments: Take away from me reproach and contempt; For I have kept thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:23
segments: Princes also sat and talked against me; [But] thy servant did meditate on thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:24
segments: Thy testimonies also are my delight [And]  my counsellors.

entries.title: Psalms 119:25
segments: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: Quicken thou me according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:26
segments: I declared my ways, and thou answeredst me: Teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:27
segments: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: So shall I meditate on thy wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 119:28
segments: My soul  melteth for heaviness: Strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:29
segments: Remove from me the way of falsehood; And grant me thy law graciously.

entries.title: Psalms 119:30
segments: I have chosen the way of faithfulness: Thine ordinances have I set [before me].

entries.title: Psalms 119:31
segments: I cleave unto thy testimonies: O Jehovah, put me not to shame.

entries.title: Psalms 119:32
segments: I will run the way of thy commandments, When thou shalt enlarge my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:33
segments: Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes; And I shall keep it unto the end.

entries.title: Psalms 119:34
segments: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; Yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:35
segments: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; For therein do I delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:36
segments: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, And not to covetousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:37
segments: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, And quicken me in thy ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:38
segments: Confirm unto thy servant thy word,  Which [is in order] unto the fear of thee.

entries.title: Psalms 119:39
segments: Turn away my reproach whereof I am afraid; For thine ordinances are good.

entries.title: Psalms 119:40
segments: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: Quicken me in thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:41
segments: Let thy lovingkindnesses also come unto me, O Jehovah, Even thy salvation, according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:42
segments: So shall I have an answer for him that reproacheth me; For I trust in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:43
segments: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; For I have hoped in thine ordinances.

entries.title: Psalms 119:44
segments: So shall I observe thy law continually For ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:45
segments: And I shall walk at liberty; For I have sought thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:46
segments: I will also speak of thy testimonies before kings, And shall not be put to shame.

entries.title: Psalms 119:47
segments: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, Which I have loved.

entries.title: Psalms 119:48
segments: I will lift up my hands also unto thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate on thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:49
segments: Remember the word unto thy servant, Because thou hast made me to hope.

entries.title: Psalms 119:50
segments: This is my comfort in my affliction;  For thy word hath quickened me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:51
segments: The proud have had me greatly in derision: [Yet] have I not swerved from thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:52
segments: I have remembered thine ordinances of old, O Jehovah, And have comforted myself.

entries.title: Psalms 119:53
segments: Hot indignation hath taken hold upon me, Because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:54
segments: Thy statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.

entries.title: Psalms 119:55
segments: I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night, And have observed thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:56
segments: This I have had,  Because I have kept thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:57
segments: Jehovah is my portion: I have said that I would observe thy words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:58
segments: I entreated thy favor with my whole heart: Be merciful unto me according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:59
segments: I thought on my ways, And turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:60
segments: I made haste, and delayed not, To observe thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:61
segments: The cords of the wicked have wrapped me round; [But] I have not forgotten thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:62
segments: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee Because of thy righteous ordinances.

entries.title: Psalms 119:63
segments: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, And of them that observe thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:64
segments: The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy lovingkindness: Teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:65
segments: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:66
segments: Teach me good judgment and knowledge; For I have believed in thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:67
segments: Before I was afflicted I went astray; But now I observe thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:68
segments: Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:69
segments: The proud have forged a lie against me: With my whole heart will I keep thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:70
segments: Their heart is as fat as grease; But I delight in thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:71
segments: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; That I may learn thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:72
segments: The law of thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver.

entries.title: Psalms 119:73
segments: Thy hands have made me and  fashioned me: Give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:74
segments: They that fear thee shall see me and be glad, Because I have hoped in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:75
segments: I know, O Jehovah, that thy judgments are righteous, And that in faithfulness thou hast afflicted me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:76
segments: Let, I pray thee, thy lovingkindness be for my comfort, According to thy word unto thy servant.

entries.title: Psalms 119:77
segments: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; For thy law is my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:78
segments: Let the proud be put to shame; For they have overthrown me  wrongfully: [But] I will meditate on thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:79
segments: Let those that fear thee turn unto me;  And they shall know thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:80
segments: Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes, That I be not put to shame.

entries.title: Psalms 119:81
segments: My soul fainteth for thy salvation; [But] I hope in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:82
segments: Mine eyes fail for thy word, While I say, When wilt thou comfort me?

entries.title: Psalms 119:83
segments: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; Yet do I not forget thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:84
segments: How many are the days of thy servant? When wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

entries.title: Psalms 119:85
segments: The proud have digged pits for me, Who are not according to thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:86
segments: All thy commandments are faithful: They persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:87
segments: They had almost consumed me upon earth; But I forsook not thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:88
segments: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; So shall I observe the testimony of thy mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:89
segments: For ever, O Jehovah, Thy word is settled in heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 119:90
segments: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: Thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:91
segments: They abide this day according to thine ordinances; For all things are thy servants.

entries.title: Psalms 119:92
segments: Unless thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

entries.title: Psalms 119:93
segments: I will never forget thy precepts; For with them thou hast quickened me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:94
segments: I am thine, save me; For I have sought thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:95
segments: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me; [But] I will consider thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:96
segments: I have seen an end of all perfection; [But] thy commandment is exceeding broad.

entries.title: Psalms 119:97
segments: Oh how love I thy law! It is my meditation all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 119:98
segments: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies; For they are ever with me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:99
segments: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For thy testimonies are my meditation.

entries.title: Psalms 119:100
segments: I understand more than the aged, Because I have kept thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:101
segments: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, That I might observe thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:102
segments: I have not turned aside from thine ordinances; For thou hast taught me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:103
segments: How sweet are thy words unto my  taste! [Yea, sweeter] than honey to my mouth!

entries.title: Psalms 119:104
segments: Through thy precepts I get understanding: Therefore I hate every false way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:105
segments: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And light unto my path.

entries.title: Psalms 119:106
segments: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, That I will observe thy righteous ordinances.

entries.title: Psalms 119:107
segments: I am afflicted very much: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:108
segments: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O Jehovah, And teach me thine ordinances.

entries.title: Psalms 119:109
segments: My soul is continually in my hand; Yet do I not forget thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:110
segments: The wicked have laid a snare for me; Yet have I not gone astray from thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:111
segments: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; For they are the rejoicing of my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:112
segments: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes For ever, even unto the end.

entries.title: Psalms 119:113
segments: I hate them that are of a double mind; But thy law do I love.

entries.title: Psalms 119:114
segments: Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:115
segments: Depart from me, ye evil-doers, That I may keep the commandments of my God.

entries.title: Psalms 119:116
segments: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live; And let me not be ashamed of my hope.

entries.title: Psalms 119:117
segments: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe, And shall have respect unto thy statutes continually.

entries.title: Psalms 119:118
segments: Thou hast set at nought all them that err from thy statutes; For their deceit is  falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 119:119
segments: Thou  puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: Therefore I love thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:120
segments: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; And I am afraid of thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:121
segments: I have done justice and righteousness: Leave me not to mine oppressors.

entries.title: Psalms 119:122
segments: Be surety for thy servant for good: Let not the proud oppress me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:123
segments: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, And for thy righteous word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:124
segments: Deal with thy servant according unto thy lovingkindness, And teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:125
segments: I am thy servant; give me understanding, That I may know thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:126
segments: It is time for Jehovah to work; [For] they have made void thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:127
segments: Therefore I love thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.

entries.title: Psalms 119:128
segments: Therefore I esteem all [thy] precepts concerning all [things] to be right; [And] I hate every false way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:129
segments: Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.

entries.title: Psalms 119:130
segments: The opening of thy words giveth light; It giveth understanding unto the simple.

entries.title: Psalms 119:131
segments: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:132
segments: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me, As thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 119:133
segments: Establish my footsteps in thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:134
segments: Redeem me from the oppression of man: So will I observe thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:135
segments: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; And teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:136
segments: Streams of water run down mine eyes, Because they observe not thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:137
segments: Righteous art thou, O Jehovah, And upright  are thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:138
segments: Thou hast commanded thy testimonies in righteousness And very faithfulness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:139
segments: My zeal hath  consumed me, Because mine adversaries have forgotten thy words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:140
segments: Thy word is very  pure; Therefore thy servant loveth it.

entries.title: Psalms 119:141
segments: I am small and despised; [Yet] do I not forget thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:142
segments: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And thy law is truth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:143
segments: Trouble and anguish have  taken hold on me; [Yet] thy commandments are my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:144
segments: Thy testimonies are righteous for ever: Give me understanding, and I shall live.

entries.title: Psalms 119:145
segments: I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O Jehovah: I will keep thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:146
segments: I have called unto thee; save me, And I shall observe thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:147
segments: I anticipated the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:148
segments: Mine eyes anticipated the night-watches, That I might meditate on thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:149
segments: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: Quicken me, O Jehovah,  according to thine ordinances.

entries.title: Psalms 119:150
segments: They draw nigh  that follow after wickedness; They are far from thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:151
segments: Thou art nigh, O Jehovah; And all thy commandments are truth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:152
segments: Of old have I known from thy testimonies, That thou hast founded them for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:153
segments: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me; For I do not forget thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:154
segments: Plead thou my cause, and redeem me: Quicken me according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:155
segments: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:156
segments: Great are thy tender mercies, O Jehovah: Quicken me according to thine ordinances.

entries.title: Psalms 119:157
segments: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; [Yet] have I not swerved from thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:158
segments: I beheld the treacherous, and  was grieved, Because they observe not thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:159
segments: Consider how I love thy precepts: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy lovingkindness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:160
segments: The sum of thy word is truth; And every one of thy righteous ordinances [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:161
segments: Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of thy words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:162
segments: I rejoice at thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.

entries.title: Psalms 119:163
segments: I hate and abhor falsehood; [But] thy law do I love.

entries.title: Psalms 119:164
segments: Seven times a day do I praise thee, Because of thy righteous ordinances.

entries.title: Psalms 119:165
segments: Great peace have they that love thy law; And they have no occasion of stumbling.

entries.title: Psalms 119:166
segments: I have hoped for thy salvation, O Jehovah, And have done thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:167
segments: My soul hath observed thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.

entries.title: Psalms 119:168
segments: I have observed thy precepts and thy testimonies; For all my ways are before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 119:169
segments: Let my cry come near before thee, O Jehovah: Give me understanding according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:170
segments: Let my supplication come before thee: Deliver me according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:171
segments: Let my lips utter praise; For thou teachest me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:172
segments: Let my tongue sing of thy word; For all thy commandments are righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:173
segments: Let thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:174
segments: I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah; And thy law is my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:175
segments: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; And let thine ordinances help me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:176
segments: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; Seek thy servant; For I do not forget thy commandments.
